title: North Pole Postal Service Tote Bag, Vintage Christmas Organic Cotton Tote, Reusable Gift Bag, Christmas Shopping Bag
description:
Special delivery from the North Pole! A vintage postage-stamp emblem with a reindeer pulling Santa's sleigh across the moon, in cream, gold and sage: "NORTH POLE POSTAL SERVICE".

The perfect bag to carry Christmas presents, groceries for the holiday dinner or gifts to friends, and a reusable gift bag that lasts long after December.

DETAILS
- 100% organic cotton canvas, sturdy and reusable
- One size: 38 x 42 cm (15 x 16.5 in)
- Long handles to carry it on the shoulder
- Colours: Black, Classic Red or French Navy
- Print on the front

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the EU (Germany) and shipped with tracking. Production takes 2-5 business days. This item ships within Europe and the UK.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
